definition: To leave someone or something permanently.
context: Ahmed stood at the door of the burning building — he had already abandoned everything inside and there was no going back.
example: I abandoned the project after it failed.

notes.curiosity: كلمة `abandon` بتخدع عشان `abandoned` كصفة معناها مهجور لكن الفعل معناها تتخلى بإرادتك

word_family.example: The abandonment of the project surprised everyone

common_examples: We had to abandon the plan after two weeks of no progress.
notes.common_mistakes: ما تقولش `abandon` لو هترجع تاني؛ ساعتها `leave` أدق
notes.try_it: قول `I abandoned the project after it failed` عن شغل سبته قريب
